messages.subject: high level interactions
parts:
Hi All,

I have been receiving the following error when attempting the following model:

First, when I attempt doing it in lme4 it works:

lmer(y ~ x1 + (x1|group) + x2[group]*x3[group], data = dt)

Here, x2 and x3 are high level predictors.

This same model does not run in INLA, giving the following error:

formula = y ~ x1 + (x1|group) + x2[group]*x3[group]

inla(formula, data = dt)

        hgid: 45844050fa62  date: Fri Jul 10 21:12:44 2015 +0200

 Report bugs to <he...@r-inla.org>

 Processing file [/tmp/RtmpXVTiOA/file125976c98f85/Model.ini] max_threads=[48]

 inla_build...

 Segmentation fault (core dumped)

 Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :

   The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.

   If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.


The following model in INLA does work:

formula = y ~ x1 + (x1|group) + x2[group] + x3[group]

However, it seems the error comes if I try to do the interaction of the group terms: x2[group]:x3[group]. This is valid in lme4 language, but I guess INLA is not quite the same and I have to specify the formula in some other way?

Any help would be much appreciated!


Ignacio

messages.author: a860e462befdcbf7
messages.subject: Re: high level interactions
parts:
Sorry, the formulas for the INLA input are wrong:

So, this doesn't work:

formula = y ~ x1 + x2[group]*x3[group] + f(beta0, model= 'iid') + f(beta1, x1,  model ='iid')

OR 

formula = y ~ x1 + x2[group] + x3[group] + x2[group]:x3[group] + f(beta0, model= 'iid') + f(beta1, x1,  model ='iid')

But this does work

formula = y ~ x1 + x2[group] + x3[group] + f(beta0, model= 'iid') + f(beta1, x1,  model ='iid')

thanks,

Ignacio
